mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_2048_score (user_id, best_score, max_tile, achieved_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bestScore}, #{maxTile}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.best_score AS bestScore, s.max_tile AS maxTile, s.achieved_at AS achievedAt, u.nickname AS nickname FROM game_2048_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_score DESC, s.achieved_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, s.best_score AS score, NULL AS secondaryScore FROM game_2048_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_score DESC, s.achieved_at ASC
